_doc: Curated MCP connectors offered to the operator in the dashboard. Spec 0029. Adding a new entry here makes it appear under /connectors. The runtime stores connector configuration in the DB after install — this file is the directory, not the source of truth.

connectors.name: Sentry
connectors.description: Errors, releases, issues across your projects.

secrets.label: Access Token
secrets.help: User Auth Token from sentry.io/settings/account/api/auth-tokens. Recommended scopes: org:read, project:read, event:read, member:read, alerts:read. (The package reads this env as `SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN` — different from SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN used by other Sentry SDKs.)

secrets.label: Host
secrets.help: Defaults to sentry.io for the SaaS. Self-hosted Sentry: set to your domain (e.g. sentry.example.com).

tools.name: analyze_issue_with_seer
tools.description: Use Seer to analyze production errors and get detailed root cause analysis with specific code fixes.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Identify the authenticated user in Sentry.

tools.name: find_dsns
tools.description: List all Sentry DSNs for a specific project.

tools.name: find_organizations
tools.description: Find organizations that the user has access to in Sentry.

tools.name: find_projects
tools.description: Find projects in Sentry.

tools.name: find_releases
tools.description: Find releases in Sentry.

tools.name: find_teams
tools.description: Find teams in an organization in Sentry.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown content of a Sentry documentation page.

tools.name: get_event_attachment
tools.description: Download attachments from a Sentry event.

tools.name: get_issue_tag_values
tools.description: Get tag value distribution for a specific Sentry issue.

tools.name: get_profile_details
tools.description: Inspect a specific Sentry profile in detail.

tools.name: get_replay_details
tools.description: Get high-level information about a specific Sentry replay by URL or replay ID.

tools.name: get_sentry_resource
tools.description: Fetch a Sentry resource by URL or by type and ID.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Search events or replays using Sentry query syntax directly (no AI/LLM required).

tools.name: list_issue_events
tools.description: List events within a specific issue using Sentry query syntax (no AI/LLM required).

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues using Sentry query syntax directly (no AI/LLM required).

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Sentry documentation for SDK setup, instrumentation, and configuration guidance.

tools.name: create_dsn
tools.description: Create an additional DSN for an EXISTING project.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project in Sentry (includes DSN automatically).

tools.name: create_team
tools.description: Create a new team in Sentry.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update a Sentry issue's status or assignment.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update project settings in Sentry, such as name, slug, platform, and team assignment.
